source_description: LOW VISIBILITY™ is a conceptual fashion and visual design project exploring minimalism, architecture, and cinematic storytelling through digital lookbooks. Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, this repository showcases the Spring/Summer 2027–2028 collection.
note: Git history and branch tips are preserved under archive/personal/*. GitHub issue/PR numbers, review threads, check runs, permissions and secrets are not Git objects. Source records remain at their original URLs. No credential values have been copied.
